text:
Nora: Quick thread  coordinating personalized thank-you bundles for hiring panel volunteers next Friday. need names, personalization rules, international shipping notes.
Diego: I can handle address collection. should we use the offboarding form or a new short form?
Katerina: New short form please  keeps privacy controls. I'll make fields: name, shipping address, t-shirt size (opt-in), prefer e-gift (yes/no), tax citizenship.
Jamal: Tax citizenship field is crucial. some contractors flagged as tax-reportable in certain countries if we send >$50 value.
Priya: FYI finance requires a recipient country column for any physical gift > $75. We'll need a CSV with that exact header.
finance-bot: Reminder: shipments to CA/UK/DE may require additional customs docs when value > "local threshold". See policy /finance/gifts.
Nora: Good catch. Katerina can you add a consent checkbox: "I consent to shipping info being used for gift fulfillment". Also opt-out for personalization (no name on merch).
Katerina: Done. Draft form link: https://intra.redwood/forms/panel-thanks-v1 (will lock Wed EOD).
Diego: Timeline: collect responses by Thu noon so procurement can print names on mugs and name tags. Production lead-time is 48 hours.
Jamal: For international recipients who prefer e-gifts, can we pre-approve a set of local vouchers? procurement lead times vary.
Priya: Procurement: we can buy bulk local vouchers but need 3 business days and vendor codes. For last-minute, send an international e-gift (USD) and offer local voucher option later.
Nora: Inventory plan: 120 bundles (30 HQ pickup, 90 ship). Each bundle = mug (optional personalization), sticker sheet, pin, thank-you card + one e-gift code if requested.
Diego: Shipping note: use consolidated batches per region to save costs. Label format must include country ISO code (e.g., GB, IE, AU).
Katerina: Personalization rules: full first name only on mug, max 12 characters; no emojis or titles. If name >12 chars, use initials. Add checkbox to override.
Jamal: For contractors, check legal: if value >$75 they might need to be invoiced instead of gifted. tagging legal to confirm.
Nora: Tagging legal now: @legal can you confirm contractor gifting rules?
peopleops-bot: FYI: legal was tagged in the #legal channel.
finance-bot: Note: set column "is_contractor" in CSV so finance can apply correct GL codes.
Diego: I'll export addresses as CSV with headers: name, country, city, postal, email, shirt_size, personalise (yes/no), is_contractor, consent.
Katerina: Communication copy to email to recipients: short note + opt-out link. Draft: "Thanks for volunteering on our hiring panels. Wed like to send a small token. Please complete this form by Thu noon. Reply to this message for questions."
Priya: Approvals: budget approved for $3,600 total (120 bundles avg $30). Any deviation >10% needs director sign-off.
Nora: Great. procurement action: bulk order mugs + stickers + 120 thank cards. Katerina will send final name list to print shop as CSV.
Diego: Shipping logistics: will use internal shipping portal and create 3 batches: NA, EMEA, APAC. I'll schedule pickups Mon night and Wed morning.
Jamal: Can we include a small paper petty-cash envelope for surprise on-site pickups? $100 float at HQ desk.
Priya: Finance: petty cash ok for up to $150. submit petty cash form before event. Code snippet for form name:
```
Petty Cash Request: PC-2026-06-01
Amount: $150
Event: Hiring Panel Thanks
```
Nora: I'll submit the petty cash request today.
Katerina: For personalization QA: will provide a preview sheet with each name next to mug mockup. ask volunteers to sign off.
Diego: Volunteer need: 2 people Wed afternoon to stuff bundles and 3 people Thurs for final packing. I'll post a signup in #all-hands.
peopleops-bot: Reminder: Add all gift items to inventory system by Tue EOD. Missing items will be auto-flagged.
Jamal: Legal replied: contractors can receive non-cash gifts up to $150 without invoicing in most jurisdictions, but check country specifics. Legal will DM exceptions.
Priya: I'll prepare the finance CSV template and upload instructions. Also include a column for "tax_reportable" default false.
Nora: One more accessibility note: offer an alternative of a donation in recipient's name (checkbox). We'll include a line on the form.
Katerina: Donation option added: list of three charities, recipient can choose one.
Diego: Shipping label test: can someone verify the EMEA address format? sending a sample label to procurement@redwood.
Priya: Procurement will validate formats; expect feedback by Tue noon.
Nora: Action items summary:
- Katerina: lock form + add preview sheet + personalization rules  due Wed EOD
- Diego: collect addresses CSV + schedule pickups + volunteer sign-up  due Thu noon for addresses, packing volunteers Wed/Thu
- Priya: prepare finance CSV template + petty cash request  due today
- Jamal: confirm contractor legal exceptions with legal  due Tue
- Procurement: vendor codes + address format validation  due Tue noon
peopleops-bot: Checklist saved: /docs/people-ops/gifts/hiring-panel-thanks-2026/checklist.pdf
Katerina: Draft email to volunteers ready, will post when form goes live.
Diego: Posting signup in #all-hands in 10.
Nora: Thanks everyone  locking plans unless someone raises a blocker by EOD tomorrow. :sparkles:
